wordProblems.q: Sam buys 7 pencils for $4 each. Sam pays with $30. How many dollars of change does Sam get?
4 friends share the cost of a $52 game equally. How many dollars does each friend pay?
Zoe watches a cartoon for 31 minutes and then plays outside for 16 minutes. How many minutes did Zoe spend in all?
Ruby needs 90 minutes to finish a puzzle. Ruby has already worked for 57 minutes. How many more minutes does Ruby need?
Ava buys 3 packs with 6 stickers in each pack, then shares all the stickers equally with 5 friends, so 6 children share them. How many stickers does each child get?
A garden is 9 metres long and 7 metres wide. How many square metres is the garden?
Mason earns $6 each week for 7 weeks. Mason buys a ball for $18. How many dollars does Mason have left?
Max puts 30 marbles into bags of 10 marbles each. Max finds 18 more marbles. How many marbles does Max have in all?
Each bus holds 24 children. 2 buses are full, and 6 more children walk. How many children are going on the trip?
A recipe needs 5 eggs for one cake. A baker makes 4 cakes and uses 8 eggs for something else from the same box. How many eggs does the baker use in all?
Each pizza has 7 slices. There are 3 pizzas. The family eats 13 slices. How many slices are left?
Liam buys 5 books for $6 each and 2 pens for $5 each. How many dollars does Liam spend in all?
Ruby practises piano for 3 hours and then for 29 more minutes. How many minutes did Ruby practise in all?
A theatre has 8 rows with 8 seats in each row. 43 seats are taken. How many seats are empty?
A teacher has 6 packs with 5 crayons in each pack. She shares all the crayons equally among 2 tables. How many crayons does each table get?
Lily gets $7 pocket money every day for 4 days. Lily spends $12 on a toy. How many dollars does Lily have left?
A cyclist rides 29 kilometres each day for 2 days. After 10 kilometres, how many kilometres are left to ride?
A garden is 13 metres long and 6 metres wide. How many metres of fence are needed to go all the way around it?
A shop buys toy cars for $5 each and sells them for $11 each. How many dollars of profit does the shop make on 7 toy cars?
Zoe plans to read 18 pages every day for 5 days. Zoe has already read 66 pages. How many pages are left to read?
Owen watches a film for 57 minutes. Then Owen takes a 17-minute break and watches the film for 30 more minutes. How many minutes does Owen spend watching the film in all?
A rug is 5 metres long and 5 metres wide. How many square metres is the rug?
A table is 10 metres long and 5 metres wide. How many metres of ribbon are needed to go all the way around the table?
Emma buys 4 rulers for $6 each and 2 erasers for $9 each. Emma pays with $50. How many dollars of change does Emma get?
A runner runs 15 kilometres each day for 3 days. After running 32 kilometres, how many kilometres are left to run?
A child buys cups of lemonade for $3 each and sells them for $8 each. How much profit does the child make on 10 cups?
A baker makes 5 trays with 7 scones on each tray. She shares all the scones equally among 5 friends. How many scones does each friend get?
James practises violin for 2 hours and 25 minutes on Saturday and for 1 hour and 50 minutes on Sunday. How many minutes did James practise in all?
Mia earns $9 each week for 3 weeks and then spends $17 on a board game. How many dollars does Mia have left?
A classroom library has 7 shelves with 8 books on each shelf. The teacher lends 22 books to another class. How many books are left in the library?
